n: A veto is the power to kill a report before it leaves the building. Anthropic's Oct. 15 post says six people from an outside evaluator now sit inside the company with employee-level access, can publish what they find without approval, and can only be made to redact narrow, predefined categories. The company set the categories and ranked its evaluators in three tiers of access. When a tool's maker says it was checked, ask who checked, what they could see, and who held the pen at the end.

sources.title: Anthropic gives an outside evaluator employee-level access and no veto over its findings, with two more evaluators named and three access tiers (Anthropic)
